tema: Energy sources: renewable (sun, wind, water) and non-renewable
objetivo: That the student identifies where the energy we use comes from, tells renewable sources (sun, wind, water) from non-renewable ones (oil, coal, natural gas) and understands why we should save energy.
hatsumon: Where does the energy we use every day come from?
